title.value: Population Genomics Approaches for Genetic Characterization of SARS-CoV-2 Lineages
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Population Genomics Approaches for Genetic Characterization of SARS-CoV-2 Lineages

extractions.description: The paper presents a set of genomic surveillance tools from population genetics to understand the evolution of SARS-CoV-2 in humans, detailing an analysis of the genetic diversity of the virus during the first year of the COVID-19 pandemic. It uses haplotype networks, Tajima’s D, and principal component analysis (PCA) to track lineage expansions and visualize genomic variation.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on genomic surveillance of a virus, which is related to public health but not directly central to sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We present here a set of genomic surveillance tools from population genetics which can be used to better understand the evolution of this virus in humans
